newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MRC Allied sees '97 net at 200 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: MRC Allied sees '97 net at 200 mln pesos.

text.p: Property developer MRC Allied Inc said on Tuesday it expected net income in 1997 to soar to 200 million pesos as it had begun marketing a flagship project this month.
Last year, the company posted a net income of 66.45 million pesos.

MRC's chief operating officer Renato Leveriza told reporters proceeds from the sale of golf shares and residential flats in its 2,266-hectare property in Leyte as well as lease payments from its industrial estate in Cebu would push revenues to 550 million pesos against 375 million last year.
